notes: Ambiguity: whether a High Dependency Unit counts as ICU (cap 10,000) or as a room (cap 5,000). Resolved as ICU, consistent with the insurer's own 0.8 proportion. If HDU were capped as a room, excess would be 8,500, ratio 0.4 and the payable far lower; the insurer's 7,500 excess matches neither reading for all three days. Underpaid by 3,800.
